name: counter-example-0
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC, TLCExt
VARIABLES x, y
Init == x = 0 /\ y = 10
Step == x < 2 /\ x' = x + 1 /\ UNCHANGED y
Back == x = 2 /\ x' = 0 /\ UNCHANGED y
Next == Step
Inv == x < 1
Prop == <> (x = 3)
Post == PrintT(CounterExample) /\ PrintT(ToTrace(CounterExample))
====
config: INIT Init NEXT Next INVARIANT Inv POSTCONDITION Post
